title: GGwave
description: GGWave is an interactive Minecraft server event plugin that increases chat activity by rewarding players for participating in short, timed “GG Waves”.
body:
GGWave is an interactive event plugin that rewards player activity in chat.
When a GG Wave starts, players simply type GG to participate.
At the end of the wave, participants receive random rewards such as crates or money, announced globally with stylish messages and sounds.
Perfect for boosting chat activity, player engagement, and server hype.
